text:
ماہ نہ رہیا — وساکھ نہ اہریا،
ساون نہ بھریا — ترے گل گئیاں۔
romanized:
Mah na rahia—Visakh na ahria,
Sawan na bharia—tré gal geia.
literal_en: Lands not left fallow in Mah, not ploughed in Visakh, and not irrigated in Sawan, are useless.

source.book: Grammar and Dictionary of Western Panjabi, as spoken in the Shahpur District, with Proverbs, Sayings and Verses
